Author: dajoey
Name: PvP Solver
Description: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
Changelog:
v0.1.0.3 - Wholly Original Rebrand & PvP Cast Protection
- Renamed all commands to /pvpsolver and /pvs to prevent collisions with stock RSR.
- Built protection against autocasting when zero enemies are nearby in PvP zones.

Author: dajoey
Name: Dagobert - Price Matcher
Punchline: Matches (instead of undercuts) market board prices
Description: Fork of Dagobert - matches the lowest market board price instead of undercutting. Default amount is 0 (exact match). You can still set a negative amount to undercut if desired.
Changelog:
v1.12.0.2 - Upstream sync: Universalis price source + fixes
- Synced upstream Dagobert through v1.13.1.0: optional Universalis data-center price source.
- Fixed HQ price detection when many NQ listings are present.
- Fixed a deadlock when no market board entries are returned.
- Clear the price cache when the price source changes; MarketBoardHandler edge-case fixes.
- Fork behavior preserved: matches the lowest price (0 undercut by default); now shows the price source.

Author: dajoey
Name: AutoPotion
Punchline: Per-job HP, MP, and deep dungeon potion automation
Description: Auto-uses the highest-tier HP potion, MP potion (Ether), and the deep dungeon regen potion (Sustaining / Eurekan / Orthos / Pilgrim's) at configurable thresholds. Each potion's threshold and on/off state is stored per-job, so casters and tanks can have completely different setups.

Author: dajoey
Name: Armoire Auto-Fill
Punchline: Per-dungeon view of which armoire-eligible gear pieces you're still missing
Description: Lists every armoire-eligible dungeon drop in the game and shows whether each is in your inventory, in your armoire, or still missing. Sort by level, hide completed dungeons, toggle to show owned items too. Open the armoire UI at an inn once per session to populate the in-armoire state; in-inventory and equipped state is detected automatically. Use /armoire.

Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.30 - BLU Complete Autorotation Engine
- Complete rewrite of BLU autorotation with full spell catalog (100+ spells).
- AoE-aware DPET scoring: automatically transitions from ST to AoE priority based on target count.
- Conditional procs (White Death, Divine Cataract) fire instantly when enabler buffs proc.
- Movement awareness: only instant-cast spells selected while moving.
- Shared recast handling (Being Mortal/Apokalypsis, Magic Hammer/Candy Cane).
- New BLU_Heal_AdvancedMode preset: heals party, raises dead, falls through to DPS when nobody needs healing.
- Still ALPHA, greedy priority, no Moon Flute burst window yet.

Author: daemitus, MidoriKami, dajoey
Name: Lazy WT Math
Description: Adds row probabilities to the Wondrous Tails display along with the average probability of what would happen if you shuffled. Upgraded for modern FFXIV.
Changelog:
v3.2.2.8 - Upstream ezwt Features
- Ported EzWondrousTails v3.2.2.6 probability updates and bingo UI.
- Preserved Dalamud API 15 / .NET 10 upgrades and unmanaged pointer detours in KamiToolKit.

Author: Blackcatz1911, dajoey
Name: Lazy Currency Spender
Punchline: Find the absolute best way to spend all your FFXIV currencies.
Description: Fork of CurrencySpender by Blackcatz1911. Never wonder 'What should I do with this?' again. Access real-time prices from Universalis, identify missing collectibles tied to your currencies, and unlock new possibilities for utilizing your in-game resources effectively.
Changelog:
v1.2.6.1 - Equipment Rendering Support
- Added new 'Equipment and Gear Exchange' section in the spending UI to display untradable, non-collectable equipment (such as Bygone Brass gear and weapons) purchased with weekly capped/uncapped endgame tomestones.

Author: croizat, dajoey
Name: Lazy Fate Automation
Punchline: Fully automated FATE grinding utilizing vnavmesh, lifestream, and Gluttony Combo.
Description: Automates FATE grinding, including Zodiac Atma, Anima Luminous Crystals, Resistance Memories, Phantom Demiatmas, Yo-kai Watch Medals, and Bicolor Gemstones. Seamlessly integrates with vnavmesh for pathing and flight, lifestream for zone swapping, TextAdvance for dialogue skipping, and Gluttony Combo/BossMod for combat. Use /lazyfate to open.
Changelog:
v0.0.1.15 - Stuck Dismounting Fix
- Fixed a bug where the bot got stuck in "Automation: Dismounting" state during zone swaps or same-zone teleports.
- Added a wait condition to ensure the dismount animation lock has fully decayed and player movement momentum has stopped before executing the teleport cast.
- Corrected task status reporting to reset back to "Teleporting" after a dismount completes.

v0.0.1.12 - Flight & Teleport Dismount Safeguard
- Added proactive landing and dismounting checks before initiating any teleportation action. If the player is mounted/flying in the air, the bot will safely descend, land, and dismount before casting Teleport, preventing silent casting blocks and infinite zone-change hangs.

v0.0.1.10 - IPC Startup & Stop Crash Protection
- Wrapped all BossMod/BMR and TextAdvance IPC calls in robust try-catch blocks to prevent unhandled IpcNotReadyError exceptions from crashing the plugin during start/stop state changes.

v0.0.1.9 - Un-Capped Logging & Diagnostics
- Routed all internal Automation task state machine events, errors, and cancellations through Svc.LogToFile.
- Improved Svc.LogToFile path resolution to dynamically detect Proton/Wine home directory structure under Linux/Bazzite (Z:\home\<username>\.xlcore\logs\) for live diagnostics.

Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy Skyward Tracker
Punchline: Track your Skyward points for all jobs toward the Pteranodon mount
Description: Lists all jobs who need points for Castle in the Sky (Pteranodon mount achievement) and their current point tally in a clean display window. Use /lazysky to open.
